result.description: Fictional portable audio mixer for field recording, podcasting, and live sound routing. Features four input channels, dual USB-C audio interfaces, onboard EQ presets, and battery-powered operation for mobile setups. Designed for creators who need a small-format control surface rather than a storage or graphics device.
